title: liparis cespitosa var. breviscapa
intro: Liparis cespitosa var. breviscapa, commonly known as Chinese Herbaceous Orchid or Breviscapa, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties that can help alleviate fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Liparis cespitosa var. breviscapa include acting as an anti-inflammatory, anti-tumor, and antioxidant agent, which can help protect against cardiovascular disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
